statements.t: • The Company has signed a definitive agreement to sell its stake in Profarma, and the transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of fiscal 2027.

Beginning in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the Company’s reporting structure will be comprised of Pharmaceutical Distribution and Services, Specialty Pharmaceutical and Provider Services, and Other.

Other, which is not considered a reportable segment, will continue to consist of businesses for which the Company is exploring strategic alternatives, including MWI Animal Health, Profarma, and the other components of PharmaLex.
The Company is reaffirming its long-term growth target that contemplates adjusted operating income growth of 7% to 10% and adjusted diluted EPS growth of 10% to 14%.

statements.t: The annual LIFO provision, which we estimate on a quarterly basis, is affected by manufacturer pricing practices, which may be impacted by market and other external influences, expected changes in inventory quantities, and product mix, many of which are difficult to predict.

Our primary ongoing cash requirements will be to finance working capital, fund the repayment of debt, fund the payment of interest on debt, fund the payment of dividends, fund purchases of our common stock, finance acquisitions, and fund capital expenditures and routine growth and expansion through new business opportunities.
We currently expect to invest approximately $900 million in capital expenditures during fiscal 2026.
We anticipate that we will continue to pay quarterly cash dividends in the future.

Our accrued litigation liability related to the Distributor Settlement Agreement, as well as other opioid-related litigation for which we have reached settlement agreements on our Consolidated Balance Sheet as of June 30, 2026 is $4.2 billion and is expected to be paid over the next 13 years.
